task.title: Unfold a category from the collapsed rail
task.description: With sidebar categories (feat/sidebar-categories, 2026-10-08) the collapsed rail shows a category as a thin divider labeled with its initials and hides its projects when the category is folded. There is no control in the rail to unfold it, so a folded category's projects cannot be reached with the pointer without expanding the sidebar first (Cmd+N and Cmd+B still reach them). Make the rail divider clickable to toggle the fold, and consider a glyph that reads less like a project key tile (a single-letter divider such as P sits beside tiles like P1).
